label: s2_side01_0050_rival_01
text: Oooh, so this is Mossui Town?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0050_rival_02
text: You all smell that, right? It kinda smells different\nthan Paldea![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0050_botan_01
text: Urrrgggh... My head’s still spinning too fast to\nsee anything... Are we there yet?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0050_friend_01
text: Maybe you wouldn’t have gotten so carsick if you\nhadn’t stared at your phone the whole bus ride.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0050_botan_02
text: But I didn’t know if we’d get signal here... I had\nto load up on internet goodness while I could...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0050_caretaker_01
text: Why, hello there![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s2_side01_0050_caretaker_02
text: Hiya, indeed. I’m the caretaker here, and it’s\na pleasure to welcome you to our town.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s2_side01_0050_caretaker_03
text: Kieran had mentioned you all would be coming.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s2_side01_0050_caretaker_04
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]
aside,
this
is
everyone’s
first
time
visiting
Kitakami,
is
that
right?[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s2_side01_0050_friend_02
text: Yeah, that’s the long and short of it.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0050_friend_03
text: What’re you saying?! It really is the first time for\nthe rest of us![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0050_caretaker_05
text: I see, I see. Well, again, you’re most welcome.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s2_side01_0050_caretaker_06
text: You can sleep here at the community center.\nAll the rooms have been freshened up for you.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s2_side01_0050_botan_03
text: Whoa... Now that’s some thoughtful service.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0050_caretaker_07
text: Hahaha! It was no trouble. Now please, relax and\nenjoy yourselves—but most of all, enjoy Kitakami![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: s2_side01_0050_rival_04
text: Thanks very much, sir![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0050_friend_04
text: So what about that Kieran guy? Have you heard\nfrom him at all?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0050_botan_04
text: EXCUSE me? He doesn’t have a smartphone?!\nHow is this kid even alive?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0050_rival_05
text: He must not want any distractions from training!\nThink he’s at his house? Should we go meet him?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0050_friend_npc
text: I’m gonna make it clear once and for all who\nyour REAL best friend is. Just you wait and see.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0050_botan_npc
text: Reception out here really is lousy. Me and my\npoor phone don’t stand a chance...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0050_rival_npc
text: Do you think Kieran’s at his house? I can’t wait to\nbat—uh, befriend him![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
